    Determinantal characterization of semistability #

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.exists_inverting_differential_of_semistable (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsAlgClosed k] (P : TwoTerm R) (M : FGModuleCat R) (hs : (eulerWeight k P).IsSemistable M) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ), ∀ t ≥ m, have Q := P.blockDifferentialOnCopies 0; ∃ (f : Q.source ⟶ Q.target), { source := Q.source, target := Q.target, projective_source := ⋯, projective_target := ⋯, differential := f }.InvertedOn M.obj

    All sufficiently large multiples of the prescribed terms admit an inverting differential for a semistable module.

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.semistable_iff_exists_inverting_multiple (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsAlgClosed k] (g : ProjectiveClass R) (M : FGModuleCat R) :
    ((projectiveClassWeight k) g).IsSemistable M ↔ ∃ (t : ℕ) (_ : 0 < t) (Q : TwoTerm R), Q.projectiveClass = t • g ∧ Q.InvertedOn M.obj

    The determinantal criterion for an arbitrary integral weight and an arbitrary semistable module over an algebraically closed field.
